title: Meera's profit, manager's commission and interest on capital
body: Meera runs a stationery business. Her capital on April 1, 2016 was Rs. 3,00,000 and she introduced no additional capital and made no drawings during the year. For the year ended March 31, 2017 the net profit before charging manager's commission and before interest on capital is Rs. 1,65,000. Her manager is entitled to a commission of 10% on the net profit after charging such commission; the commission is unpaid at the year end. Meera also wants to know the profit after allowing interest on capital at 5% per annum on her opening capital, to be provided after the manager's commission. The interest is to be credited to her capital account, and the final net profit is to be transferred to her capital account.
